summary: The ad hoc evolution path is detailed enough to build. Recipe-based workspaces are underspecified (creation kind, scaffold, preservation checks, kind in input equality), and the biggest gap is that the persisted EvolutionReport has no place for the package comparison and producing-flow data other ADRs require.

questions.text: ADR 0015 requires a plugin-package comparison, and ADR 0028 the producing recipe/flow, to be saved with the candidate and accepted report, but ADR 0010's EvolutionReport and EvolutionRecord hold only the kind and step reports.
questions.reason: This changes the committed result.dhall and candidate.dhall formats and their shape-directed decoding. ADR 0010 has 'data EvolutionReport = EvolutionReport EvolutionKind [StepReport]', and ADR 0015 says 'Save this comparison with the candidate and accepted report so inspection does not consult live package files'.

questions.text: Does the manifest's kind take part in captured-input equality, given that changing the kind must invalidate the saved candidate?
questions.reason: Leaving kind out would let acceptance publish a candidate evaluated under the old kind. ADR 0010 says 'Changing it or rebasing invalidates the saved candidate', but input equality lists only 'Before revision, name and explanation, and the exact before/target/change paths and bytes'.

questions.text: At which stage, against what comparison and with which outcome is a recipe-based workspace refused for changing schema, recipe definitions, source or configuration?
questions.reason: This enforces the guarantee that recipe runs change only facts and state, and it decides whether a candidate is saved. ADR 0010 says only 'compare captured source/configuration as well', with no stage, file set or diagnostic.

questions.text: How does CreateEvolution receive the EvolutionKind and selected recipe, and does it check that the recipe exists in Before?
questions.reason: The capability signature and the 'evolution new --recipe' wiring depend on it. CreateEvolution takes only 'KnowledgeBase -> EvolutionName -> GitRevision', yet 'Creation selects an ad hoc or recipe-based scaffold from EvolutionKind' (0010, 0018).

questions.text: What does creation write as the initial change/Evolution.hs for a recipe-based workspace, given that no identity RecipeEvolution exists?
questions.reason: The scaffold must name the recipe's state type and compile as a no-op, which affects the SDK surface. Only the ad hoc 'evolution = identityEvolution' scaffold is specified, and RecipeEvolution is built only through recipeEdit with a Rationale (0010).

questions.text: Is rebasing a Kyyn operation that rewrites before.revision and recopies before/ from the new commit, or a manual edit?
questions.reason: Capture refuses any mismatched before/ copy, so rebasing by hand means recopying all of src/ after every acceptance elsewhere. ADR 0010 says 'rebasing refreshes them', but there is no EvolutionAuthoring constructor or CLI command.

questions.text: What is the explicit operation that removes an unaccepted workspace, and does it also clear its saved candidates?
questions.reason: ADR 0010 requires 'an explicit operation, preserving unrelated files', but EvolutionStore and ADR 0018's evolution commands (new/list/show/check/ready/draft/accept) define none.

questions.text: Which operation computes the Before root's validation report during preview, and where does checkEvolution return it?
questions.reason: It needs PrepareRoot/ValidateRoot on Before and a result slot. ADR 0010 says 'Preview surfaces the source validation report separately', but checkEvolution returns only 'Either PreviewRejection (CheckResult (Candidate (Validated Root)))'.

questions.text: Where in the workspace layout is a closed recipe's frozen proposal stored, and is it a captured evaluation input?
questions.reason: Editing it must invalidate the candidate, and projection rejects files outside the layout. ADR 0028 says only 'Persist returned steps and next state through the ordinary Dhall path', and ADR 0010 says 'Projection rejects other files outside the layout'.

questions.text: Are superseded .kyyn/candidates/<id>/ result directories ever reclaimed, and by whom?
questions.reason: Each save writes a full materialized root, so local storage grows without bound. ADR 0010 says only 'older result directories are never modified by a subsequent save'.

questions.text: Does the EvolutionRecord carry a format version, and how are committed records read after Kyyn changes the record or report shape?
questions.reason: Accepted archives are committed history. ADR 0012 defers 'durable version/readability policy' to 0010, and ADR 0010 offers only that 'Authors may repair old manifests and reports on disk', with no version tag or reader policy.

questions.text: ADR 0008 says generated Kyyn.Workspace.Evolution re-exports only Kyyn.Evolution, while ADR 0010 says it re-exports the public evolution, diagnostic and fact vocabulary and its examples use Fact and FactId through it.
questions.reason: This fixes the generated export list, the --evolution discovery catalogue and whether scaffolds compile with one import. ADR 0008 says 'reexports only Kyyn.Evolution ... not a mixed collection of schema/runtime modules' and 'Authors import Kyyn.Schema separately when constructing facts'.

questions.text: ADR 0010's creation and ADR 0015 copy 'all non-fact root files' into target/, but ADR 0014 stores recipes in root/recipes.dhall and root/recipes/, and ADR 0010's projection rejects those paths under target/.
questions.reason: Read literally, every new workspace fails its own projection, though ADR 0010 elsewhere says recipes 'are produced by evolution, not edited in a parallel ... target/recipes.dhall'. ADR 0015 says 'New evolutions inherit all accepted non-fact root files'.

questions.text: Must the manifest explanation be nonempty before MarkReady or acceptance?
questions.reason: Creation writes 'an initially empty explanation', yet it is the only rationale for source-only changes (0010). Accepted archives could otherwise carry no explanation.
